name: Cancelled Status Reason 2 Code
definition: Specifies the underlying reason for cancellation of the associated transaction.

CANH.name: Cancelled By Hub
CANH.definition: Transaction is cancelled by the hub.

CANP.name: Cancelled By Instructing Party
CANP.definition: Transaction is cancelled by the instructing party.

CXLR.name: End Of Life
CXLR.definition: Transaction is rejected by the executing party, the rejection is final therefore the order is cancelled in the system.

CANO.name: Cancelled By Other
CANO.definition: Transaction is cancelled by a party other than the instructing party, eg, a market infrastructure such as a stock exchange.
